label: population includes subgroup members
definition: Population X is explicitly described as including people of demographic subgroup Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit population including people from Y; a stated subgroup among the described population; historical described populations. Excludes: ordinary organizational membership or corporate ownership; geographic containment alone; mere comparison, proximity, or interaction; inferring that every member of Y belongs to X. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic include with unclear demographic roles; unclear population versus person or organization; a subgroup attachment to another population. This asserts textual inclusion of subgroup members in the population being discussed, not universal set containment Y subset X.

facts.reason: Westerners → Americans: Explicit include and demographic-member context states that the described Westerners include Americans; this does not claim universal set containment.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
